title: Word formation
instructions: Use the word in CAPITALS to form a word that fits the gap.

items.q: The new policy has been ______ criticised by experts. (WIDE)
There is growing ______ that the system needs reform. (RECOGNISE)
His ______ to compromise caused the talks to collapse. (WILLING)
The advertisement was deliberately ______. (LEAD)
We were impressed by the ______ of her argument. (CLEAR)
The results are ______ with previous research. (CONSIST)
It was a completely ______ decision; nobody saw it coming. (EXPECT)
The company faces ______ competition from abroad. (INCREASE)
He apologised for his ______ behaviour at the meeting. (RESPECT)
Some of the paintings in the collection are ______. (REPLACE)
Poor ______ of resources led to the project's failure. (MANAGE)
The ______ of the new bridge took three years. (CONSTRUCT)
She has a remarkable ______ to stay calm under pressure. (ABLE)
Many young people feel ______ with politics. (ILLUSION)
The data was ______ interpreted, which led to the wrong conclusions. (CORRECT)
Economic ______ has improved over the last decade. (STABLE)
The two proposals are ______ different. (FUNDAMENTAL)
His ______ comments offended several colleagues. (THINK)
The government aims to ______ the tax system. (SIMPLE)
There was a clear ______ of opinion among the experts. (DIVIDE)

title: Word families in context

title: Key word transformations
instructions: Write only the missing words (3-6 words, including the word in CAPITALS).

items.q:
I'm sure she didn't take the money. CAN'T
She ______ the money.

It was wrong of you to shout at him. SHOULD
You ______ at him.

I regret not studying harder at university. WISH
I ______ harder at university.

The concert was cancelled because of the storm. CALLED
The concert ______ because of the storm.

She was the only one who noticed the mistake. APART
Nobody ______ the mistake.

I found it difficult to understand his accent. DIFFICULTY
I ______ his accent.

It's possible that they missed the train. MAY
They ______ the train.

People say that the castle is haunted. SAID
The castle ______ haunted.

He didn't realise how serious the situation was. LITTLE
______ how serious the situation was.

"Don't forget to lock the door," she told me. REMINDED
She ______ the door.

The film was so boring that I fell asleep. SUCH
It ______ that I fell asleep.

I haven't seen Mark for ages. SINCE
It's ______ Mark.
a: been ages since I last saw
been ages since I have seen

items.q:
We postponed the meeting until next week. PUT
The meeting ______ until next week.

Whatever you say, I won't change my mind. MATTER
No ______, I won't change my mind.

She is likely to win the election. CHANCES
The ______ win the election.

I only realised my mistake when I got home. UNTIL
It ______ I got home that I realised my mistake.

They will make the final decision next week. MADE
The final decision ______ next week.

Tom is not as experienced as Sarah. LESS
Tom ______ Sarah.

You must not tell anyone about this under any circumstances. ACCOUNT
On ______ anyone about this.
a: no account are you to tell

items.q:
I'd prefer you not to smoke in here. RATHER
I'd ______ in here.
